Strategy: Widen the gentle fifteen sweet band to residuals between twenty-eight and forty-eight with a lighter mid penalty of ten. This keeps most Best Fit behavior intact, but the weak penalty may rarely change any ranking.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 48 else 0) - (10 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
